Un égaliseur paramétrique à vous, en plu: Your own parametric equaliser on top of the headphone profile (in series, 64-bit): its bands stay when you change headphones.
Stéréo : la couche stéréo du SACD quand: Stereo: the SACD's stereo area when the disc has one, otherwise an ITU mix (centre and surrounds at −3 dB, LFE left out) computed in 64-bit DXD. Multichannel: every channel as soon as the DAC has enough outputs, even with a 2-channel profile.
Sortie du DAC de chaque enceinte en mult: DAC output of each speaker in multichannel (SACD / WAV order: L R C LFE Ls Rs). Two speakers on one output: standard order.
L = AvG + 0,707 C + 0,707 SurrG (idem à: L = FL + 0.707 C + 0.707 SL (same on the right), LFE left out, normalised: no clipping
Le mixage stéréo du disque, lu tel quel: The disc's own stereo mix, played as is instead of the multichannel area
Modulateur sigma-delta 1 bit en 64 bits: 1-bit sigma-delta modulator in 64-bit floating point (DoP or native DSD). If the DAC does not take the chosen rate, the next lower one; without DSD, PCM stays as it is. Suspended while the Studio Tools / AURA DSP are on.
PCM 0 dBFS = SACD 0 dB plus this headroom. A look-ahead limiter caps the peaks (inter-sample ones included) at -0.9 dB SACD before the modulator: never clipping nor instability.
PCM -> DSD suspendu : les Outils Studio: PCM -> DSD suspended: the Studio Tools / AURA DSP work in PCM
PCM -> DSD : le DAC n'accepte pas le DSD: PCM -> DSD: the DAC takes no DSD (neither native nor DoP)
AURA DSP / Outils Studio en DXD 64 bits: AURA DSP / Studio Tools in 64-bit DXD ->
Garder la sortie DSD pendant un traiteme: Keep the DSD output while processing
Source DSD avec AURA DSP / Outils Studio: DSD source with AURA DSP / Studio Tools or a 5.1 -> 2.0 mix: DSD -> 64-bit DXD -> processing -> DSD modulator (same order and headroom). Off: DXD output (PCM 352.8 kHz).
FIR 64 bits, 150 dB (le DSD d'origine n': 64-bit FIR, 150 dB (the original DSD is no longer sent as is)
Sortie sans fil (Bluetooth / AirPlay) ou: Wireless output (Bluetooth / AirPlay) or "Fixed" mode: the rate the system set is kept, no renegotiation between tracks
Auto (suit la source ; fixe en Bluetooth: Auto (follows the source; fixed on Bluetooth / AirPlay)
Un DAC filaire suit la fréquence de chaq: A wired DAC follows each track's rate (bit-perfect). A Bluetooth or AirPlay output keeps the rate the system set: every change renegotiates the link (pops, drop-outs); Aura then converts in 64 bits.
Supprime les pops au démarrage, à la pau: Removes pops at start, pause, stop, track skip, seek and rate change. Never between two gapless tracks. Off: strictly bit-perfect from the very first sample.
Cloche dynamique sur la bande : seules l: Dynamic bell on the band: only the sibilance goes down, nothing else moves.
Plateau doux au-dessus de la fréquence,: Gentle shelf above the frequency, only when the treble goes over the threshold.
De-esser transparent, sibilances et aigu: Transparent de-esser, sibilance and harsh treble
Seuil automatique (part des aigus dans l: Automatic threshold (share of treble in the signal). Below it, the output is bit-identical to the input.
Modulateur sigma-delta 1 bit en 64 bits: 1-bit sigma-delta modulator in 64-bit floating point (DoP or native DSD). XZ Automatic: 44.1 kHz -> DSD64, 48 / 88.2 / 176.4 kHz -> DSD128, 96 kHz and above -> DSD256. If the DAC does not take the chosen rate, the next lower one; without DSD, PCM stays as it is. AURA DSP / Studio Tools apply in DXD before the modulator.
Baisse automatiquement les sibilances («: Automatically lowers sibilance ("s", "sh") or harsh treble around the chosen frequency, only when it sticks out. The rest of the spectrum does not move.
Masters modernes très brillants et voix: Very bright modern masters and close-miked vocals are less tiring, especially on headphones or a lively tweeter.
Tant qu'il est actif, plus de bit-perfec: While it is on, no bit-perfect; a DSD source goes through 64-bit DXD. Below the threshold, the output stays bit-identical to the input.
Suréchantillonne le PCM vers 352,8 / 384: Upsamples PCM to 352.8 / 384 kHz with a 64-bit polyphase sinc filter, before the DAC.
Utile avec un DAC dont le filtre interne: Useful with a DAC whose own filter is average at 44.1 / 48 kHz: the filtering happens here, steeper and cleaner. No effect on a DAC that already upsamples very well.
Plus de bit-perfect, charge CPU un peu p: No bit-perfect, slightly higher CPU load; the DAC changes rate less often (always 352.8 or 384 kHz).
Mélange un peu de chaque voie dans l'aut: Blends a little of each channel into the other, filtered and delayed as when listening to speakers (Bauer bs2b 700 Hz / 4.5 dB).
Au casque : moins de fatigue sur les vie: On headphones: less fatigue with old hard-panned mixes (1960s jazz, rock), the image moves back in front of you.
Inutile sur enceintes ; stéréo un peu mo: Pointless on speakers; slightly narrower stereo; no bit-perfect while it is on.
Baisse le niveau juste ce qu'il faut ava: Lowers the level just enough before the equalisers so that their boosts never go over 0 dBFS.
Aucune saturation numérique quand un EQ: No digital clipping when an EQ lifts the bass or treble, even on masters already at full scale.
Le volume baisse de la valeur de la plus: The volume drops by the largest boost: make it up on the amplifier. No effect when no EQ is on.
Corrige la courbe de réponse d'un casque: Corrects the response of a measured headphone towards a neutral target (built-in profiles, 64 bits).
Casques colorés (basses gonflées, pic da: Coloured headphones (boomy bass, treble peak): truer timbres, more natural vocals.
Valable pour le modèle choisi seulement: Valid for the chosen model only; no bit-perfect; headroom lowers the level a little.
Auto suit la fréquence du morceau, sauf: Auto follows each track's rate, except on a wireless output (Bluetooth, AirPlay) where the rate set by the system is kept. "Always follow the source" and "Fixed" force one or the other.
Enceinte ou casque Bluetooth : plus de c: Bluetooth speaker or headphones: no more dropouts or pops between tracks at different rates.
Fréquence fixe : les morceaux d'une autr: Fixed rate: tracks at another rate are converted (64-bit sinc), so no bit-perfect for them.
Ajoute un fondu de 10 ms au démarrage, à: Adds a 10 ms fade at start, pause, stop, track skip, seek and rate change.
Plus de « pop » ni de clic aux coupures,: No more pops or clicks at breaks, most audible on headphones and on DACs that relock.
Jamais entre deux morceaux enchaînés san: Never between two gapless tracks (gapless intact). Off: strictly bit-perfect from the very first sample.
Transforme le PCM en DSD 1 bit (modulate: Turns PCM into 1-bit DSD (64-bit sigma-delta modulator, order 5 or 7). XZ Automatic picks the rate from the source: 44.1 kHz -> DSD64; 48 / 88.2 / 176.4 kHz -> DSD128; 96 kHz and above -> DSD256.
Avec un DAC qui sonne mieux en DSD Direc: With a DAC that sounds better in DSD Direct (1-bit path without a PCM filter): often a smoother, airier presentation.
Plus de bit-perfect ; CPU d'un cœur : ~1: No bit-perfect; one CPU core: ~12% at DSD64, ~21% at DSD128, ~39% at DSD256. No gapless between two different DSD rates (10 ms fade). Automatic fallback to the DAC's highest rate.
Une source DSD qui doit être traitée (AU: A DSD source that must be processed (AURA DSP, 5.1 -> 2.0 mix) goes to 64-bit DXD and back to DSD instead of leaving as PCM.
Le DAC reste sur son chemin DSD : utile: The DAC stays on its DSD path: useful if you prefer it in DSD Direct.
Le DSD d'origine n'est plus transmis tel: The original DSD is no longer passed through as is (remodulated); modulator CPU load; an EQ change is heard with ~0.5 s of delay.
Copier ces informations (texte brut), pa: Copy this information (plain text), e.g. for a bug report

Mesure en tâche de fond le vrai pic de c: Measures in the background the real peak of each track between the samples (True Peak, ITU-R BS.1770-4, 4× oversampled). If that peak exceeds the ceiling (-1.0 or -0.5 dBTP), the track is lowered by exactly the excess, before any conversion, equaliser or DSD modulator.
Plus de saturation sur les masters moder: No more clipping on modern masters that touch 0 dBFS but exceed 0 dBTP: DAC reconstruction, DXD upsampling and DSD modulation stay clean. A track already under the ceiling keeps 0 dB: its dynamics and bit-perfect playback are untouched.
Un morceau baissé n'est plus bit-perfect: A lowered track is no longer bit-perfect (64-bit gain + dither). On the first listen, the attenuation arrives as soon as the measurement ends (10 ms glide); after that it is known from the first sample. DSD source: True Peak shown only. Network streams are not measured.
Source DSD : affichage seulement, le flu: DSD source: display only, the 1-bit stream is not modified
Non mesuré (mesuré en tâche de fond à la: Not measured (measured in the background when a file plays)
Auto-Headroom True Peak : baisse seuleme: Auto-Headroom True Peak: lowers only the tracks whose True Peak exceeds the ceiling
